Featured Logos (`section-regular no-padding-mob logo-mob`) - CREATE `src/components/home/featured-logos.module.css` - REWRITE `src/components/home/featured-logos.tsx` ### 3. Portfolio Carousel (`section-regular-2 img-slider-sec`) - CREATE `src/components/home/portfolio-carousel.module.css` - REWRITE `src/components/home/portfolio-carousel.tsx` (client, embla-carousel) ### 4. Pain Points (`section-regular-3 slowing-sec`) - CREATE `src/components/home/pain-points.module.css` - REWRITE `src/components/home/pain-points.tsx` ### 5. Resolution Banner (`blue-card-sec`) - CREATE `src/components/home/resolution-banner.module.css` - REWRITE `src/components/home/resolution-banner.tsx` ### 6. Built For (`built-seccc`) - CREATE `src/components/home/built-for.module.css` - REWRITE `src/components/home/built-for.tsx` ## CRITICAL RULES - CSS module must contain EXACT Webflow CSS values — copy verbatim - Use bracket notation for hyphenated classes: `styles['section-regular-3']` - Include ALL media queries for each class - Images: `/images/webflow/FILENAME` — get exact filenames from the HTML - `"use client"` only on typewriter.tsx and portfolio-carousel.tsx - NO `any` types - Text content WORD FOR WORD from HTML - The typewriter cycles: "Ownership Driven", "Without Hiring", "On Demand" - The portfolio carousel has 4 categories: Shopify, WordPress, Figma UI/UX Design, Banners ## HOW TO EXTRACT CSS For each class, grep the FULL CSS file to get all occurrences (base + responsive): ```bash grep -A 10 "\.class-name" boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css ``` START NOW. Read HTML, extract CSS, write files.
